subject: biology

hotspots.label: Small subunit
hotspots.description: The lower half of the ribosome that holds the message in place while it is read.
hotspots.function: Grips the message so the code can be read.

hotspots.label: Large subunit
hotspots.description: The upper half that links amino acids together as they arrive.
hotspots.function: Links the amino acids into a growing protein chain.

hotspots.label: Message-reading site
hotspots.description: The channel where the message passes through and is read, one codon at a time.
hotspots.function: Reads the coded message to decide which amino acid comes next.

hotspots.label: Amino-acid joining site
hotspots.description: The slot where each new amino acid is added to the growing chain.
hotspots.function: Adds each amino acid to build the protein.

visualStyleNotes: Anatomy Atelier bar throughout: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with a soft radial vignette beneath the model, no floor grid, no scene props. Clean stylized-specimen quality - museum-model cross-section caps, never gore. COLOR IS RESTRAINED: the organelle reads as a calm warm-paper specimen; each structural part is modeled in a muted near-neutral shade (warm taupe, pale vanilla, soft slate), never a saturated legend color. Strong saturated color is reserved entirely for the small flat-colored hotspot dots.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0, matte roughness ~0.5-0.65. Interior fluid (if any) is softly translucent but not glassy; cross-section cuts are clean flat museum caps. No emissive channels anywhere.
assetBrief: SUBJECT: a single ribosome as a study model - two rounded subunits (a smaller one, a larger one) nestled together to form the classic ribosome silhouette, shown in a clean cutaway so the message channel is visible. Between them, a short ribbon represents a messenger code strand threading through the read-site channel, with a few small muted spheres (amino acids) stacked on the joining site. Warm-paper materials, muted accents, no glow. Named nodes: SmallSubunit, LargeSubunit, MessageStrand, AminoAcidStack. Budget 8-12k.
